raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly prioritized the "primary country" release date (Bangladesh for Niyoti) over the actual earliest public release date (India for Niyoti) when determining which film came out earlier. While the Planner established a rule to use IMDb Release Info for consistency, it failed to recognize that the question "Which film came out earlier" refers to the first time the film was available to the public, regardless of the primary production country. By ignoring the June 10, 2016 release in India (which was earlier than the August 12, 2016 release in Bangladesh), the Planner reached the wrong conclusion that Angali Pangali was earlier, whereas Niyoti actually had an earlier release date globally.
